event.name: 7 September 1999 Athens (Attica), Greece, earthquake
event.tectonic_setting: Thriassion–Fili fault system, Attica, normal faulting. Origin and hypocenter follow Papadimitriou et al. (2000) coordinates used for this study; literature locations differ by kilometers.

reference.title: Slip Distribution of the 7 September 1999 Athens Earthquake Inferred from an Empirical Green’s Function Study
reference.journal: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America, 93(2), 775–782

inversion.method: Empirical Green’s function deconvolution of regional broadband horizontal-component waveforms, inversion of source-time functions on a 25 x 25 1-km-square fault mesh.
inversion.green_function_model: Empirical Green’s function: M4.5 aftershock at 20:32:27 UTC on 7 September 1999, with waveforms from regional stations; fault-plane ray paths approximated in a half-space.
inversion.notes: FIGURE-DIGITIZED GRAYSCALE, NOT PUBLISHED NUMERIC PATCH DATA.

provenance.compiled_by: Digitization of Figure 5 from Roumelioti et al. (2003), PDF page 6. Original 25x25 1-km panel, interpreted gray classes. QA estimates and confidence flags in companion CSV; published summary values retained separately. Reconstructed sampled peak 0.75 m; total printed positive cells 76/625. Not original inversion coefficient file.
